name: beehiiv
description: beehiiv lets agents read posts, subscribers, and performance data, and draft posts in the publications of the signed-in account. Each user signs in to their own beehiiv account through the browser.

prompts.text: Which of my last ten posts had the best open and click rates?
How did my subscriber count change this month, and from which sources?
Draft a post that announces our new pricing.

apps.name: beehiiv
apps.description: Post, subscriber, and analytics tools, over beehiiv's MCP server with browser sign-in.
